title: Daewoong Pharmaceutical to Lead 5.3 Billion Won AI Drug Formulation Project
description: Daewoong Pharmaceutical will lead a 5.3 billion won state-funded project to build an AI platform designing drug formulations and manufacturing processes…

title: The US and China Agree to Reduce Tariffs and Initiate AI Dialogue
description: The US and China have agreed to ease the tariff regime for goods valued at $30 billion each. The countries also plan to discuss the risks and benefits of artificial intelligence and establish a communication channel for AI-related incidents.

title: Crime is still crime when an AI is involved — the perps are the humans
description: These tools aren’t uncontrollable, sentient creatures. The folks behind them are the decision-makers, to blame for whatever harm their products do.

title: US energy department allocates $5.25 billion to upgrade grid for AI datacenters
description: The US Department of Energy committed $5.25 billion to upgrade the electric grid for AI datacenters, directly tackling power bottlenecks. Anthropic also locked in an $11.6 billion cloud deal with Akamai, betting on a CPU-centric architecture over GPU-heavy norms.
